content:
kevin: Heads-up: rate-limit controller misread env var MAX_RPS in prod causing throttles for small customers. Seen 429 spike in us-central1 since 11:02 UTC. I pushed a hotfix image (sha: b7a1d9f) that corrects parsing logic. Need fast approvals and region-pinned rollout to us-central1.

maria: can you summarize risk/rollback plan? any migrations needed?

kevin: no schema changes. Risk: if logic still wrong we could under-throttle -> bursty upstream load. Rollback plan: immediate pin back to previous image gcr.io/redwood/runtime:prod-2026-03-20 (sha: a9f4c2b). Monitoring hooks: datadog rps+429, svc queue depth. Requesting canary 5% for 7m then 25% -> 100% if stable. Ops signoff needed for expedited.

sam: QA ran smoke on staging, parsing fix validated. release note: "fix: rate-limit env parsing bug causing unexpected 429 responses for small workloads". docsbot: will draft blurb for status page.

ops-oncall: I can watch. Rollback triggers: 429 rate > 1% sustained for 3m OR avg latency up >200ms. Ill stay on thread and escalate if thresholds hit.

maria: approving for us-central1 only. :thumbsup: @releasebot pls tag hotfix/rateparse-2026-03-23 and attach release note.

releasebot: Tagging hotfix/rateparse-2026-03-23 and attaching notes: https://release.redwood/hotfixes/rateparse-2026-03-23

deploybot: Request: canary -> us-central1 -> 5% -> image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime:hotfix-b7a1d9f sha=b7a1d9f
deploybot: /deploy canary us-central1 5% image=gcr.io/redwood/runtime:hotfix-b7a1d9f sha=b7a1d9f
deploybot: Canary started (id: cb-6318004321). Hooks: datadog/rate_limits + traces. First metrics in ~4m.

kevin: logs pasted for context:
``
[11:02:12] WARN rate_limit: expected int for MAX_RPS, got "50" (string)
[11:02:12] INFO rate_limit: applied default 100 for tenant=small-tenant
[11:02:15] ERR api: 429 user=abc123 route=/v1/gen
```

ops-oncall: initial canary metrics: 429 rate 0.2%, p95 latency +8ms. holding.

sam: QA smoke is green at 5%. docsbot: status page draft posted.

maria: proceed to 25% in us-central1.

deploybot: Rolling canary to 25% (cb-6318004321).

ops-oncall: 429 rate 0.3%, latency +10ms. good. traces show parse path executed as expected.

kevin: pushing cherry-pick PR to main: PR #4239. Will merge after 30m stable watch.

maria: final approve for 100% in us-central1. confirm delay for wider rollout?

kevin: yes hold on global rollout until we verify cross-region stability. only us-central1 now.

deploybot: Rolling to 100% in us-central1... Deploy successful (cb-6318004321). Post-deploy checks passing.

ops-oncall: monitoring 30m. If no regressions, close incident and schedule stable release to other regions tomorrow.

sam: thanks all. I'll merge PR #4239 to main and cut a release branch.

kevin: filing incident summary and tagging INC-8032. Notifying customer success for affected tenants.

ops-oncall: closing after 30m watch if metrics remain below thresholds. :white_check_mark:
